description: The non-negotiable teaching gates (improvement list L59, docs/AUTONOMOUS-LOOP-POLICY.md section 6). They run on every loop pull request whatever its tier (scripts/ci/plan.mjs runs every unit test on loop/ branches), and a loop pull request may add new files beside them but never edit or delete one: the trusted merge decision sends any such PR to Tim. A failure is never accepted by a golden or baseline update inside a loop PR.

gates.rule: A hidden answer never reaches pupil artwork
Blank, zero, hidden and answer-line states stay distinct through save and reload
Saved files from earlier versions keep loading identically
No editor chrome in exports; physical size and type size never shrink
Outputs change only through an accepted golden
Saved-file schemas and the MCP catalogue change only with Tim
